trap.label: give rise to
trap.wrong: Vague wording gives rise for disputes.
trap.right: Vague wording gives rise to disputes.
trap.why: Em português “dar origem a” tem a preposição a, mas o aluno escolhe for/of por influência de outras estruturas. Em inglês, give rise to é fixo.

mcq.q: Better than a passive “were given rise to”:
A near synonym of give rise to:

fix.wrong: Poor wording gave rise a legal challenge.
fix.right: Poor wording gave rise to a legal challenge.

fix.wrong: The clause gave rised to a challenge.
fix.right: The clause gave rise to a challenge.

fix.wrong: The clause gives rises to doubt.
fix.right: The clause gives rise to doubt.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com give rise to: “Ambiguity leads to disputes.”
Passado: “The clause gives rise to a challenge.”
rewrite.answer: The clause gave rise to a challenge.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com modal: “The wording gives rise to doubt.” (may)
rewrite.answer: The wording may give rise to doubt.
